source_resources.title: tiktoken: Fast byte-pair encoding tokenizer used by OpenAI models
source_resources.author: OpenAI
source_resources.relevant_timestamp: README: encoding.get_encoding("cl100k_base"), encode/decode API, special token policy
source_resources.permission_basis: Lawful external hyperlink to public repository; no code imported.
source_resources.selection_rationale: Production reference that contrasts a teaching tokenizer's explicit vocab dict with industrial byte-level BPE ranks and special tokens.
source_resources.known_availability_limitations: GitHub repository is public; encoding BPE ranks load from OpenAI-hosted blobs on first use.
source_resources.safe_fallback: The lesson's vocabulary/id exercises run entirely on a local Python dict with fixed expected values.

compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Broad production tokenizer framework with training APIs; tiktoken is a cleaner contrast for GPT-style compatibility claims.
Widely used trainer/tokenizer for open models; treated as further production context rather than the contrast reference.
